Hi all — thanks for the attachments, Amelia. I've reviewed the W-9 and vendor form; a few follow-ups before I can provision a vendor code and enroll ClearStream in early-pay: 

Required to provision vendor code:
- Completed vendor onboarding form (looks mostly filled; please confirm bank account and remit-to address fields)
- Copy of commercial insurance (certificate) or a waiver if not applicable
- Signed copy of Redwood's supplier terms (I can send a one-page acknowledgement PDF if preferable)

Early-pay eligibility checklist:
- Banking ACH confirmation (voided check or bank letter)
- 12 months of invoice history (or references) for credit assessment — if you don't have Redwood history we'll accept 3rd-party references + a short trade ref form.
- Confirmation of no outstanding disputes with prior customers (one-line statement)

Process notes:
- Portal uploads are preferred (https://vendorportal.redwood.com). If you upload, add "Onboarding: ClearStream" to the invoice notes so it routes to my queue.
- If enrolled, early-pay offers are executed via our AR partner. Net term remains Net45 on the invoice; the payment schedule will show an early-pay settlement line. Enrollment is typically effective within one week of completing docs and passing the quick credit touch.

Amelia — I'm attaching a short spreadsheet that spells out the early-pay economics and the enrollment form. If you can return the missing items, I will assign a vendor code and trigger the portal invite.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Accounts Payable Manager | Redwood Inference
